messages:
nina: kicking off schema roll (idx+backfill) to prod-canary now. plan: canary -> staged -> ramp. will monitor replication closely.
arthur: reminder: pin service and disable canary autoscale during index apply. did preflight apply?
nina: preflight passed but autoscale flag didn't sync. pinning service to v4-canary and starting index with low mem.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @nina at 2026-03-21T17:33:54Z. Steps: create-index-concurrent -> backfill-async -> promote
db-eng: after index create started, replica-1 lag jumped to ~90s. seeing WAL burst from parallel workers
sre-oncall: paging thresholds hit at 80s. recommend pausing staged jobs and running replica catchup.
nina: hold remaining stages. deploy-bot, hold 1791122334-stages
deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged for staged jobs by @nina.
db-eng: mitigation: reduce maintenance_work_mem and restart walreceiver on replica-1. running soft restart now
docs: adding release-note: "Index started on canary; paused due to replica lag. Catchup in progress; will resume at low traffic."
sre-oncall: extending migration window by 30m and adding temporary alert rule for lag >120s
arthur: rollback plan if catchup fails: drop index concurrently, revert feature flag, restore replica from snapshot. we should also note this in release notes
nina: catchup finished, lag down to 4s. ready to resume at 1% with concurrency cap 2. everyone ok? :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Resuming at 1% traffic per @nina.
sre-oncall: monitoring for 30m. will escalate if lag >30s.
arthur: follow-up action: add preflight check to assert autoscale disabled during index apply and include a pinned service step in the runbook
ina: closing holdpoint, will post a short postmortem and update runbook. thanks all.
